notes.title: New Construction Simulator to be released in 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6208663/6209fd77c2cf8d566630d26f6d0d67f57bed42ec.jpg[/img]

True to the slogan “GET TO WORK”, today we are happy to announce the long-awaited next instalment in the Construction Simulator series. The new Construction Simulator is coming to PC on September 20, 2022 – including a co-op multiplayer, an unprecedented fleet of exciting construction vehicles and machines as well as numerous new and significantly expanded features. Construction Simulator is available for pre-order right now. Look forward to the most extensive and authentic construction simulation of the series to date!

https://youtu.be/0uAgCTBWZVw

[b]Construction Simulator:[/b]
[list]
[*]Successor to the popular Construction Simulator game series
[*]Most extensive fleet in the game series’ history
[*]Officially licensed vehicles, machines, attachments and workwear from 25 well-known brands
[*]Two huge and completely new maps: EU and US setting, each with an extensive campaign
[*]Entirely revised mission system including a multitude of challenging contracts
[*]Open world with day and night cycle
[*]Improved vehicle and earthmoving system
[*]Officially licensed work clothes
[*]Completely revamped, modern graphics
[*]Co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players
[*]To be released on September 20, 2022 – now available for pre-order!
[/list]

With its enormous selection of officially licensed vehicles and machines from already known, as well as numerous newly added well-known manufacturers and brands, Construction Simulator not only offers the most extensive fleet in the game series’ history to date, but also countless new features and expanded functions.

In addition to the large number of vehicles, simulation fans and fans of heavy construction machinery may also look forward to two huge and completely new maps, where they can work their way up from a small building contractor to the largest construction giant within the respective region. Regardless if you are playing in the US-American or the European setting: thanks to the completely open game worlds with a dynamic day and night cycle and the entirely revised mission system including its two campaigns as well as a multitude of varied and challenging missions, in Construction Simulator you are free in your decisions on how to lead your company to success.

Next to this, the game will excite you with its completely revamped, modern graphics and an improved vehicle and earthmoving system, as well as a sophisticated cooperative multiplayer mode. Another new feature of Construction Simulator: officially licensed work clothes!

Construction Simulator will be released on September 20, 2022. More detailed information as well as the option to pre-order the game is available here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273400

notes.title: Liebherr A 918 DLC & Deluxe Edition available now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6208663/61a748676409a9c9ae180e390fca7d5630fb32c5.jpg[/img]

Good news: [b]Construction Simulator 2015: Liebherr A 918[/b] DLC as well as the comprehensive [b]Construction Simulator Deluxe Edition[/b] are now available here on Steam!

The [b]Construction Simulator 2015: Liebherr A 918[/b] DLC is the eighth official expansion of [b]Construction Simulator 2015[/b] and offers faithful fans of the franchise not only the long-desired Liebherr A 918 mobile excavator but also a Liebherr L1-24 fast-erecting crane as well as the Liebherr R 956 crawler excavator. Three powerful machines that players will be able to put to the test in three new exciting missions. notes.content:
Dear community,

we are happy to present you the latest and so far most extensive update for Construction Simulator 2015 today. Next to the new virtual vehicle hall as well as the long awaited advanced support for modding vehicles in multiplayer games the update also includes language support for Turkish and Brazilian Portuguese as well as a bunch of additional game improvements. Here is a detailed overview:

Patch notes: 

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed internal crash when exiting the game with (e.g. Alt+F4 on Windows)
[*]Improved communication with Steam to determine if the game is running
[*]Fixed missing text in Large Excavator tutorial
[*]Crawler crane assembly is aborted if the vehicle is sold
[*]Sold vehicles get properly unregistered from locations
[*]Improved Mod-Vehicle import (e.g. if Shaders are missing)
[*]Target indicator implemented for Mod-Vehicles (e.g. Hook-Component) 
[*]Preview pictures for Mod-Vehicles implemented
[*]Outriggers of the small trailer have a larger threshold for their retracted state
[*]Improved automatic steering of the Semi LowLoader and the Heavy-duty Trailer to reduce the amount of time it takes for those trailers to re-align themselves
[*]Fixed incorrect hydraulics behaviour on excavator shovels
[*][MP] Fixed multiplayer synchronization of Mod-Vehicles (e.g. "Mammoet" Trucks)
[*][MP] Fixed drag of cargo objects already connected to a hook for joining players
[*][MP] Improved initial positioning of cargo objects for joining players
[*][MP] Improved ramp collider behaviour of the Lowboy Trailer for Clients, making it easier to drive vehicles on it
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the update of a player’s active mods after unsubscribing a mod and restarting the game
[*]Fixed an issue which would show mission indicators for cargo objects too early in a mission
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Steam API Update
[*]Language added: Turkish
[*]Language added: Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Mouse cursor gets hidden on inactivity
[*]Mod-Vehicles are tagged in the motorpool menu
[*]Launch option "-console" activates an ingame error log (Ctrl + ,) which should help with mod debugging
[*]Rotating lights stay activated when exiting a vehicle and have to disabled manually
[*]If a contract requires the construction site of the hospital, players get an additional prompt to confirm/decline the removal of the hospital.
[*]Launch option "-resetSpecialMission" allows players to reset and replay previously finished contracts (e.g. the early stadion missions). This option requires the ID for each mission (e.g. "-resetSpecialMission=m3050_stadium_001"). Applicable missions are:
[list]
[*]g0000_homebaseCity_001
[*]g0000_industrial_001
[*]g0000_vehicleTrader_001
[*]g2020_hotel_001
[*]g2030_developmentArea_001
[*]g2030_hollywoodHills_001
[*]g2030_hollywoodHills_002
[*]g3050_industrial_002
[*]m2030_School_001
[*]m2030_School_003
[*]m2030_specialPool_001
[*]m3050_specialPool_002
[*]m3050_stadium_001
[*]m3050_stadium_002
[*]m3050_stadium_003
[*]m4040_School_002
[/list]
[*]Added the option to re-import Mods in order to simplify testing. Requires the launch option "-modDebug"
[list]
[*]Mod-Vehicles can be re-imported by clicking their (new) mod-indicator in the motorpool menu. The vehicle needs to be inactive.
[*]All Mod-Missions can be re-imported with the Refresh button in the architect missions menu. Currently active missions aren’t updated before their next start.
[/list]
[*]"Vehicle Hall" added (Motorpool menu)
[list]
[*]Vehicles can be stored, allowing players to have a larger amount of vehicles in their possession
[*]Running expenses for stored vehicles are halved
[*]Automatically unlocked with the acquisition of the larger company grounds
[*]Max amount of active vehicles: 30 (6, before acquiring the larger company grounds)
[/list]
[*]When creating an multiplayer game, players can enter a short description of their game, which will be visible to other players in the game’s lobby before joining
[*]The following settings of a multiplayer game can be changed retrospectively:
[list]
[*]Password
[*]Max Players
[*]Game Description
[*]Min. Player Level
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Mod Editors[/b] 
We also updated the mod editors for missions and vehicles. You can find them in the corresponding discussions in steam.

There are issues with the XBox One Controller on Windows 10, which unfortunately can’t be fixed without causing problems on Windows 8 and previous versions. We have uploaded a special version for Windows 10  for players experiencing these control issues. (The version is identical otherwise)

Right-Click Construction Simulator in your Steam Library -> Properties -> Betas -> Select "windows10"

After a short update, the version should be adjusted. (May requires a steam restart to trigger the download)

notes.content:

Dear community,

2016 is a busy year for us. We have already achieved great steps, but there is still much to do. According to plan we will provide Construction Simulator 2015 with new, high quality content and also present you one or two surprises till the end of this year.

The first of these steps will be the upcoming update for Construction Simulator 2015 which is already under construction. In addition to various game improvements and bug fixes, this update will also bring a virtual vehicle depot into the game. The depot can be used to store currently unneeded vehicles. This way all problems connected to the limited number of parking lots at your homebase should belong to the past. With the update players will be able to hold multiple vehicles of the same type, which is great for multiplayer sessions, and also have additional mod vehicles in the fleet without having to sell vehicles when space is running low. Among other things the new DLC packs will contain the long-awaited A918 wheeled excavator of our partner LIEBHERR® as well as a four-axle MAN® TGX D38 truck. More detailed information will follow in time - so stay tuned!

Parallel to the development of the update and the next DLCs for Construction Simulator 2015, we are already working on a new project for smartphones and tablets, which we will reveal soon. At this point once again a big thank you for your years of loyalty and support. We are already looking forward to 2016 and for sure will continue on this crazy year together with you!

Your weltenbauer. team

notes.title: Construction Simulator 2015 Major Update (v.1.2)
notes.content:
[h1]Englisch[/h1]

Today we are releasing the newest version of Construction Simulator 2015, which will bring you several bug fixes and some smaller features. 

Note: Four missions were updated during the work on this patch. Therefore this missions are aborted automatically on the first start after this patch.

Patch notes: 

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed currency format on statistics screen
[*]Fixed some cargo- and vehicle loading bugs
[*]Hide HUD input is working again
[*]Updated Steam SDK
[*]Improved vehicle & trailer resets
[*]Improved multiplayer stability
[*]Improved vehicle motor force in combination with loaded trailers
[*]Improved excavator and forklift blocking
[*]Changed the layout of some locations to soften steep ramps
[*]Fixed positioning of several traffic lights
[*]Improved AI traffic behaviour
[*]Improved performance
[*]Improved fill state visualization of concrete forms
[*]Fixed various problems with cargo objects and loading areas
[*]‘Think about purchasing new vehicle’ reminder is no longer shown once the player has reached the correct threshold (15 vehicles)
[*]Fixed issue with a DLC mission being available (although not completable) for players without the DLC
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]New vehicle added to the vehicle dealer: Escort Vehicle (Stops NPC traffic in a wider area once activated. Can be used to keep crossings empty for larger vehicles.)
[*]Vehicles and trailer are now restored to their actual last position before “safe” fallback positions are considered
[*]Vehicles transported on trailers should now be properly restored
[*]Reset / sell all cargo functions added to cargo screen
[*]Reset all vehicles to homebase button added to motorpool screen
[*]Indicators to vehicle quick selection added (own vehicle, driver seat taken)
[*]Vehicle buttons in quick selection are now disabled if all seats are taken
[*]Added new region (Australia) for multiplayer games
[*]Added content and logic for DLC 2
[/list]

[b]Important Note: Only players with the same version see each other in multiplayer. So make sure you are up to date.[/b]

Heute veröffentlichen wir ein neues Update für den Construction Simulator 2015 

Note: Vier Missionen wurden während der Arbeit an dem aktuellen Patch angepasst. Diese Missionen müssen leider automatisch abgebrochen werden, falls sie gerade aktiv sind.

Patch notes: 

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Währungsformatierung in Statistik-Menü korrigiert
[*]Kamera-Anpassungen für Fahrzeuge mit Anhängern werden beim Zurücksetzen wieder richtig gesetzt 
[*]Das HUD kann wieder per Taste ausgeblendet werden
[*]Steam SDK aktualisiert
[*]Das Zurücksetzen von Fahrzeugen und Anhängern wurde verbessert
[*]Mehrspieler-Stabilität wurde verbessert
[*]Die Zugkraft von Fahrzeugen mit beladenen Anhängern wurde verbessert.
[*]Blocken beim Bagger und bei dem Gabelstabler verbessert
[*]Einige Orte wurden angepasst und steile Rampen bzw. harte Kanten abgemildert
[*]Platzierung einiger Verkehrsampeln verbessert
[*]Verhalten der KI-Fahrzeuge verbessert
[*]Performance-Verbesserungen
[*]Visuelle Darstellung des Fortschritts beim Gießen von Wänden und Pfeilern verbessert
[*]Verschiedene Probleme im Bereich Ladung und Ladeflächen behoben
[*]“Du könntest dir ein neues Fahrzeug leisten” Erinnerung wird nicht mehr angezeigt, sobald der Spieler mehr als 15 Fahrzeuge besitzt
[*]Problem behoben bei dem eine DLC Mission angenommen aber nicht abgeschlossen werden konnte, wenn der Spieler den DLC nicht besitzt
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Ein neues Fahrzeug kann beim Händler erworben werden: Das Begleitfahrzeug (Mit Hilfe seiner Wechselverkehrszeichenanlage kann es KI-Autos in einem erweiterten Bereich stoppen und zum Beispiel Kreuzungen für größere Fahrzeuge freihalten.)
[*]Fahrzeuge und Anhänger werden beim Laden eines Spielstands auf ihre letzte tatsächliche Position zurückgesetzt, falls möglich. Ansonsten wird auf die letzte sichere Position zurückgegriffen.
[*]Auf Anhängern transportierte Fahrzeuge werden wieder richtig wiederhergestellt
[*]Neue Funktion: Alle Waren zurücksetzen / verkaufen (Warenlager-Menü)
[*]Neue Funktion: Alle Fahrzeuge auf das Firmengelände zurücksetzen (Fuhrpark-Menü)
[/list]

[b]Wichtiger Hinweis: Nur Spieler mit der selben Version können gemeinsam im Multiplayer spielen. Seid also sicher, dass ihr immer auf dem aktuellen Stand seid.[/b]
